policies.title: Equality & Diversity
policies.content: RSA Chambers is committed to equality and diversity in all aspects of its work. We do not discriminate on any grounds and our policies apply to all members, pupils, staff and those seeking to join Chambers.

policies.title: Legal Services
policies.content: All advocates at RSA Chambers are regulated by the Bar Council of India and are subject to the Professional Standards applicable to the legal profession. Our advocates provide independent, specialist legal advice and representation.

policies.title: General Services
policies.content: RSA Chambers provides a wide range of services to clients and instructing solicitors. Our team is available Monday to Saturday, 10:00am to 6:00pm, to assist with all aspects of instructing an advocate, including obtaining quotes and arranging conferences.

policies.title: Response Times
policies.content: We aim to respond to all enquiries within 24 hours on working days. For urgent matters, our team will endeavour to respond as quickly as possible. If any delay is anticipated, the client will be informed promptly.

policies.title: Fees & Billing
policies.content: RSA Chambers is committed to transparency in all matters relating to fees and billing. Fee quotes are provided before work commences wherever possible. Fees are agreed with the relevant advocate before instructions are accepted.

policies.title: Complaints
policies.content: RSA Chambers has a formal complaints procedure. If you are unhappy with any aspect of the service you have received, please contact the head of chambers in the first instance. All complaints are investigated thoroughly and we aim to resolve them promptly.

cards.title: Criminal Law
cards.description: Representation in Sessions Courts, High Court and Supreme Court across the full range of criminal matters from bail applications to complex trials.

cards.title: Civil Litigation
cards.description: Disputes involving contracts, property, torts and other civil matters before district courts, civil courts and appellate forums.

cards.title: Family & Matrimonial
cards.description: Divorce, custody, maintenance, adoption and all matrimonial disputes handled with sensitivity and expertise.

cards.title: Constitutional & Public Law
cards.description: Writ petitions, judicial review and public interest litigation before the Rajasthan High Court and Supreme Court of India.

cards.title: Revenue & Land
cards.description: Land acquisition, revenue disputes, tenancy matters and all land-related litigation before revenue courts and civil courts.

cards.title: Labour & Employment
cards.description: Industrial disputes, service matters, wrongful termination and employment law before labour courts and tribunals.

cards.title: Motor Accident Claims
cards.description: Representation for claimants and insurers in motor accident tribunal proceedings to secure maximum just compensation.

cards.title: Consumer Protection
cards.description: Claims before District, State and National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions on behalf of aggrieved consumers.

cards.title: Property & Real Estate
cards.description: Title disputes, partition suits, easements, injunctions and all matters relating to immovable property.

cards.title: Matrimonial Property
cards.description: Matrimonial property rights, dowry matters, domestic violence cases and protection orders under applicable law.

cards.title: Bail & Anticipatory Bail
cards.description: Expert representation in bail and anticipatory bail applications before Sessions Courts, High Court and Supreme Court.

cards.title: Arbitration & ADR
cards.description: Representation in domestic and international arbitration, mediation and conciliation proceedings as an alternative to court litigation.

knowledge.supportingText: RSA Chambers advocates regularly provide insight and commentary on current legal matters affecting our clients. We also provide guidance and resources on recent developments in Indian law.

join.introText:
As a growing set of chambers, RSA Chambers welcomes applications from advocates who share our commitment to excellence and client service.

With offices in Jaipur and Kotputali, we have opportunities for advocates at all stages of their careers.

RSA Chambers is committed to equality and diversity in all its practices.
